name: Unseen Servant

components.m: a bit of string and of wood

targets.description: an unoccupied space on the ground

summary: An invisible, mindless force that does simple chores at your command for 1 hour.
text: An Invisible, mindless, shapeless Medium force appears in an unoccupied space on the ground within range and does simple tasks for you for 1 hour. It has AC 10, 1 Hit Point and a Strength of 2, and it can't attack; the spell ends if it drops to 0 Hit Points. Once on each of your turns, as a Bonus Action, you can mentally command it to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object. It can do simple jobs a human could, such as fetching, cleaning, mending, folding clothes, lighting fires, serving food and pouring drinks; it keeps at a task as best it can until it is done, then waits for your next command. If you give it a task that would take it more than 60 feet away from you, the spell ends. Can be cast as a Ritual.
